definition: an atom or molecule that carries an electric charge because it has gained or lost one or more electrons

collocations.example: Chlorine typically forms a negatively charged ion in solution.
The water filter uses ion exchange to remove minerals.

definition: a unit of frequency equal to one million hertz, often used to measure processor or radio speed

collocations.example: Early computers ran at only hundreds of megahertz.
Radio frequencies are usually measured in megahertz on this dial.

definition: a short daily meeting where a team reviews progress and plans the day's work

collocations.example: We start each day with a short daily scrum.
All developers must attend the scrum before starting their tasks.

definition: the feeling of not being able to believe that something is true or real

collocations.example: He shook his head in disbelief at the news.
A look of disbelief crossed her face during the speech.

definition: a tiny particle in the nucleus of an atom that carries no electric charge

collocations.example: Astronomers detected signals from a distant neutron star last year.

definition: to defend yourself against a blow or a difficult question by turning it aside

collocations.example: The minister tried to parry a question about the scandal.

definition: a scented liquid, lighter than perfume, that people put on their skin to smell pleasant

collocations.example: He likes to wear cologne when he goes out.

definition: to take action in order to prevent something from happening or to stop someone else acting first

collocations.example: The company issued a statement to preempt criticism.

definition: a stringed musical instrument like a violin but slightly larger and lower in sound

collocations.example: She learned to play the viola at a young age.
The concert opened with a beautiful viola solo.

definition: a common freshwater or sea fish with a flat, deep body, often caught for food

collocations.example: The angler was thrilled to catch a large bream at dawn.

definition: an extra note added at the end of a letter after the signature

collocations.example: She decided to add a postscript to thank him again.

definition: a nobleman ranking below an earl or count and above a baron

definition: a letter of an ancient alphabet once used by northern European peoples

definition: a small, high-pitched flute often played in military or marching music

collocations.example: The young soldier learned to play the fife during training.

definition: a mound of stones built as a landmark or memorial, often on a trail

definition: a woman admired as the most beautiful and charming person at an event

definition: showing a complete lack of courage; shamefully cowardly

collocations.example: His craven behavior during the crisis disappointed the entire team.

definition: a long-term loan to a company that pays fixed interest but is not secured by assets

definition: a rounded, thick hairstyle in which naturally curly hair is grown out evenly

collocations.example: He chose to wear an afro throughout his college years.

definition: a small songbird with a short, strong beak used for cracking seeds

collocations.example: A singing finch landed on the feeder outside the window.
Birdwatchers were excited to spot a rare finch in the woods.

definition: a person who owns or rents and lives in a house

definition: the action or state of one thing sticking firmly to another

collocations.example: The new glue provides strong adhesion between metal and glass.
Cleaning the surface first will improve adhesion of the paint.

definition: a chemical substance that neutralizes acids and dissolves in water

collocations.example: A strong alkali can burn the skin if handled carelessly.
Workers used a mild acid to neutralize the spilled alkali.

definition: a smaller group that is part of a larger set or group

collocations.example: Only a small subset of customers responded to the survey.

definition: the place where a person has their permanent legal home

collocations.example: She listed the city as her permanent domicile for tax purposes.

definition: a large tree-dwelling ape with long arms and reddish-brown hair, native to Asia

collocations.example: The sanctuary cares for an endangered orangutan rescued from poachers.
Visitors can observe an orangutan swinging through the tall rainforest trees.

definition: a spear with three sharp prongs, often shown held by sea gods

collocations.example: The statue shows a sea god carrying a massive trident.

definition: to select, organize, and present items such as art or information

collocations.example: She was hired to curate an exhibition of modern paintings.

definition: a soft, thick bed covering filled with feathers or synthetic material

definition: to arrange text and images into a form ready for printing

definition: to communicate and cooperate with others in order to coordinate work

definition: existing only as an idea or in theory, not as something real

definition: a small, brightly colored bird that catches fish near rivers and lakes

definition: a period when someone rules a country because the monarch is too young or unable

definition: a sum of money collected from several people for a shared purpose

definition: to collect and arrange information or documents in the correct order

definition: a small wild plant with pale yellow flowers that blooms in early spring

definition: a return to a former state, condition, or type

definition: a very small, active brown bird with a short upright tail

definition: a small bus that carries a limited number of passengers

collocations.example: The hotel offers a minibus to the airport each morning.

definition: to separate grain from the rest of a plant by beating it

definition: to supervise students during a test or examination to prevent cheating

definition: a small worm that attaches to the skin and sucks blood

collocations.collocation: a leech attached to his leg

definition: a soft, white, waxy substance used to make candles and seal containers

definition: a book that lists words together with other words of similar meaning

definition: a person who promises to be responsible if someone else fails to pay a debt

definition: a thick, sweet paste made from sugar, used to cover or decorate cakes

definition: immediately, without any delay

definition: an Australian animal like a small kangaroo that hops on its back legs

definition: a flat shape with three or more straight sides

definition: an important or powerful person in an organization

definition: a small brown bird known for singing beautifully, especially at night

definition: the string in a candle or lamp that you light so it burns

collocations.example: She lit the wick with a long match.

definition: to make the loud, harsh sound that a donkey makes

definition: the lowest female singing voice, or a singer with this voice

collocations.example: She usually sings alto in the church choir.

definition: a small group of specially trained or skilled people in an organization

collocations.example: A small cadre of experts advised the new mayor.
